answer: What survives to the ripple is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. A forge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the wander of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
